title: JWT Inspect
summary: Decodes a JWT on the page, without sending it anywhere, and flags alg none, key confusion, expiry and readable secrets.
description: Local JWT decoder that never sends the token anywhere and flags alg none, HS vs RS key confusion, an expired token or future nbf (in the reader's zone), millisecond timestamps, a missing aud or iss, very long lifetimes, and secrets or personal data readable in the payload.
catches: alg none, and algorithms outside your allow-list
HS/RS confusion (HMAC where an RSA key is expected)
Expired token or nbf in the future, shown in local time
Timestamps in milliseconds instead of seconds
Missing or wrong aud/iss, very long lifetime
Secrets or personal data readable in the payload
limits: Decodes only; the signature is never verified
Secret and PII detection is pattern-based
Doesn't make a token safe to use; your server must verify it
a11y: Visible label; input has aria-invalid and is described by the local-only note and the report
Report uses role=status; icons are aria-hidden
Clear button has an aria-label and returns focus to the field
server: Verify the signature, algorithm, issuer, audience and expiry on the server with a JWT library and a pinned key.

sources.label: RFC 8725: JSON Web Token Best Current Practices

rules.note: Informational. Checked RFC 8725's guidance on alg none and algorithm substitution; individual thresholds (lifetime, leeway) are product defaults, not standards.

stops: Helps keep live tokens out of online decoders
